display_long_description:
Innoactive Portal enables you to deploy your VR content to devices anywhere. This includes streaming complex PC based enterprise VR apps from the cloud to your Meta Quest/ Quest 2 / Quest Pro.

Innoactive Portal app for Meta allows you to stream enterprise VR apps from the cloud. 

Target audience: 
- Enterprise users that want to access VR apps from their organization
- VR training managers that want to deploy VR training in their organization
- VR enthusiasts that want to experience VR cloud streaming using NVIDIA CloudXR

How it works
1. You need to have access to Innoactive Portal cloud. If you do not have access, go to https://www.innoactive.io and request an account.
2. For VR streaming, you need to have an internet connection with a bandwidth of at least 50 Mbps
3. Go to your Portal web app select "Connect device".
4. Enter the device pairing code shown in the headset on the Portal web app.
5. Select an app, either in VR or on the Portal web app and hit "Run in cloud"
6. Wait for the VR cloud streaming to be prepared. This can take a minute or two. 
7. Experience VR cloud streaming!
